title: 卡西奥佩娅·花园小镜
description: 金冠蛇身卡西奥佩娅盘坐花园，用小镜整理头饰，上身着完整高领衣装。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Cassiopeia is an adult woman with a long serpentine lower body, green-gold scales, an ornate golden cobra-inspired crown, and long dark hair. Keep her face expressive and friendly, without a threatening open mouth. Cover her upper body in an opaque long-sleeved emerald tunic with gold trim, retaining the distinctive continuous coiled snake tail rather than substituting human legs.
art_direction.scene: She coils comfortably beside a low garden bench and uses a small hand mirror to straighten a little flower tucked against her crown. One pot of pale blossoms and a smooth archway frame the scene. The tail forms a soft readable curve around a cushion, with plenty of space between the coils and her hands.
art_direction.palette: emerald, pale gold, cream blossom, dusty peach
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
